(function(){ var D = DOGS.m.D, r = D.root; r.updateMatrixWorld(true); var lo = DOG.lowest(D), ry = r.position.y, rc = new THREE.Raycaster(new THREE.Vector3(r.position.x, ry + 0.9, r.position.z), new THREE.Vector3(0, -1, 0), 0, 3), nm = '', fl = null; TK.T.root.traverse(function (m) { if (!m.isMesh || !m.visible || !m.geometry || m.isInstancedMesh) return; for (var p = m; p; p = p.parent) if (p.visible === false) return; if (!m.geometry.boundingSphere) m.geometry.computeBoundingSphere(); var h = rc.intersectObject(m, false); if (h.length && (fl == null || h[0].point.y > fl)) { fl = h[0].point.y; nm = m.name || m.type; } }); return JSON.stringify({ at: 'platform', mode: D.mode, modeT: +D.modeT.toFixed(1), lift_cm: +((D.lift || 0) * 120).toFixed(1), lowestUnderRoot_cm: +(lo * 120).toFixed(1), rootOverFloor_cm: fl == null ? null : +((ry - fl) * 120).toFixed(1), lowestOverFloor_cm: fl == null ? null : +((ry + lo - fl) * 120).toFixed(1), floor: nm, zone: TC.zone }); })()
